title: Identity, Security, and Configuration
description: Implement application authentication and authorization with Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC, managed identities, Key Vault, and App Configuration.
longDescription: This module covers Azure identity and configuration services. You will learn how to register applications in Entra ID, authenticate users and services, secure secrets with Key Vault, manage feature flags with App Configuration, and apply least-privilege access with RBAC and managed identities.
whatYouLearn: Register applications in Microsoft Entra ID
Implement OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect flows
Use managed identities to avoid credentials in code
Secure secrets, keys, and certificates in Key Vault
Manage configuration and feature flags with App Configuration
Apply RBAC at the right scope for applications
